title: Define a complete public Tarium domain ontology
abstract: Maintain a project-owned, self-contained ontology documenting domain entities, attributes, identifiers, relationships, semantics, sources and versioning, with mutually consistent human-readable and machine-readable descriptions.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
